tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List Render services the API key can see (id, name, type, repo, branch, suspended state), newest filters optional

name.description: Optional service name to filter by

type.description: Optional service type to filter by

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get one Render service by its service id (type, repo, branch, root dir, auto-deploy and suspended state)

service_id.description: Render service id from list_services (e.g. srv-abc123def456ghi789jk)

tools.name: list_deploys
tools.description: List deploys for one Render service, newest first (status, trigger, commit, timings)

service_id.description: Render service id from list_services (e.g. srv-abc123def456ghi789jk)

status.description: Optional deploy status to filter by

tools.name: list_owners
tools.description: List the Render workspaces (owners) the API key can see, which supplies the ownerId other filters take

name.description: Optional exact workspace name to filter by

needs_review: Field names and query parameters are taken from the OpenAPI document Render embeds in its own api-docs.render.com reference pages (schemas serviceWithCursor, deployWithCursor, ownerWithCursor, service, deploy), not from a live 2xx: no Render account was held, so the proof below covers wiring only, never payload shape.

Every Render list endpoint answers with a TOP-LEVEL array of envelope objects ([{ service, cursor }], [{ deploy, cursor }], [{ owner, cursor }]), so the three list tools use the spec v1.1 root-array pick {"[]": ...} and reach inside the envelope with dotted sources (service.id, deploy.commit.message). The netlify spec in this repo predates that pick form and is truncate-only for the same shape; these tools do not need to be.

The scaffolded bearer auth stands: Render's own securitySchemes block is { BearerAuth: { type: http, scheme: bearer } }, and a dummy bearer draws a structured 401 {"message":"Unauthorized"} from /v1/owners, /v1/services and /v1/services/{id}/deploys alike. Nothing in the live evidence or the docs contradicts the scaffold, so nothing was changed.

One request per tool (spec v1 limit) means no pagination: every list tool returns each row's `cursor` but there is no next-page tool to spend it on, and limit is capped at Render's documented ceiling of 100 (its own default is 20).

serviceDetails is deliberately NOT picked. It is a polymorphic block (a different object per service type: static site, web service, private service, background worker, cron job) and flattening it would need a per-type pick that spec v1 pick cannot express. The type-independent identity, repo, branch and suspended fields are picked instead.

No _probe hints are set. Render has no public service or owner id to hint with, and none is needed: the 401 lands before any identifier is looked up, so a made-up srv- id and a real one are indistinguishable to a blind probe.

What the shape-proof can and cannot say here: Render answers the deliberately bogus control path with a plain-text 404 and every real /v1 path with a structured JSON 401, so the differential proves host, TLS, base_url, path and the Authorization header name per tool. It proves nothing about response fields, and a real key is what would flip those same calls to 2xx.
